scorecard.rationale: Anxiety values and the exact statistical contrast are unavailable for the refined sunflower and sesame comparison. A separate depression trial combines oral sunflower oil with positive suggestion and reports composite well-being including relaxation, without an isolated anxiety outcome. Neither study identifies a cold-pressed sunflower effect on Parkinson anxiety. The original Labrousse combined diets both include sunflower oil. Pressing method and anxiety are outside the reported comparison. The reviewed cannabinoid patent mentions sunflower oil as a vehicle. It gives no cold-pressed oil comparison or anxiety estimate.
